analysis: Decision value of the existing protected anonymous-quantile rules
selection: minimum purchased-site annual HVAC energy; existing absolute/relative tie rule and lexical physical_action_id
reference: minimum energy plan passing both complete-distribution service limits in the identical library
outcomes: missing selection despite a full-qualified plan
unmatched_rule: retain every design case; do not turn missing choices into zero regret
carbon_rule: compare the operational CO2 attached to the energy-minimizing choices; do not call this a carbon optimum
dynamic_rule: do not infer demand-response regret from annual quantile scores
stop_rule: complete these three existing rules and both existing split schemes once, verify existing reference outcomes, stop without tuning thresholds
